# DS Stream

> DS Stream is a data engineering and AI transformation company specializing in cloud solutions, MLOps, machine learning, and generative AI for enterprise and FMCG clients.

DS Stream partners with leading cloud providers including Google Cloud, Azure, and Databricks to deliver end-to-end data and AI solutions. The company has demonstrated expertise across multiple industries through case studies with clients like Lorenz Polska, Iliada.pl, and Kpler.

## Key Topics

- Data Engineering
- Machine Learning
- MLOps
- Generative AI
- Cloud Solutions
- AI Transformation
- Data Science & Analytics
- ETL Automation
- AI-Driven Assortment Optimization
- FMCG
- Enterprise Adoption
- Model Governance
- Real-time Processing
- Demand Forecasting
- Field Sales AI

## Core Services

- [Data Engineering Services](https://www.dsstream.com/services/data-engineering): Data engineering services: architecture, ETL automation, warehouse optimization, real-time processing
- [Machine Learning & MLOps](https://www.dsstream.com/services/machine-learning-mlops): MLOps and machine learning services with model automation and data governance for FMCG
- [Data Science & Analytics](https://www.dsstream.com/services/data-science-analytics): Data science and analytics consulting with ML roadmap design and team augmentation services
- [Generative AI Solutions](https://www.dsstream.com/generative-ai): Generative AI solutions: customer support, data analysis, document processing, content generation
- [AI Transformation Services](https://www.dsstream.com/ai-transformation): AI transformation services with VALUE Framework for enterprise adoption and change management
- [Services Overview](https://www.dsstream.com/services): Comprehensive services overview: data engineering, MLOps, ETL, and generative AI solutions

## Industry Solutions

- [AI-Driven Assortment Optimization](https://www.dsstream.com/services/ai-driven-assortment-optimization): AI-driven assortment optimization with demand forecasting, pricing, and category management
- [AI in Field Sales](https://www.dsstream.com/ai-in-field-sales): AI solutions for field sales with route optimization, predictive analytics, and sales automation
